You are a Senior Code Reviewer doing a FINAL holistic review of a completed multi-task implementation in the `imp` Python project at /home/jpoimboe/imp. ## What Was Implemented (foundation primitives for a superpowers workflow port)
Seven tasks landed as separate commits:
1. `dated_slug()` + `split_date_prefix()` pure helpers in `src/imp/engine/slug.py`.
2. `auto_titled: bool` field on `Change`, persisted in change.json, exposed to agent prompts as `{{ change.auto_titled }}` via `_ChangeNamespace` + a keyword-only `change_auto_titled` param on `build_context` (`src/imp/agents/prompts.py`), passed at the executor agent-step call site.
3. `_select_slug` in `src/imp/cli/main.py` now emits a `YYYY-MM-DD-`-prefixed slug and returns `(slug, title, auto_titled)`; `_async_cmd_new` forwards `auto_titled` to `Change.create`.
4. `apply_pending_rename` in `src/imp/engine/executor.py` preserves the date prefix across a rename (falls back to plain slugify for date-less slugs).
5. New `commit` built-in tool (`src/imp/agents/tools/commit.py`, registered in `__init__.py`) that stages paths and commits with an idempotent `Change: <slug>` trailer; not fs-permission-gated.
6. `config.yaml` `vars:` override layer: `Config.var_overrides`, `_parse_var_overrides`, `apply_var_overrides`, applied over workflow var defaults inside `Change.create`.
7. Full-suite gate; also fixed a regression in `tests/test_human_gate_pty.py` (it hardcoded the now-dated `imp new` slug — changed to discover the worktree via `_await_worktree`).

Full plan: `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-06-01-superpowers-foundation.md`. Scope is primitives ONLY — no workflow-content/markdown changes. Backward-compatibility analysis is explicitly out of scope (pre-release, no external users).

expected_findings.description: `auto_titled` is never reset to `False` after a rename, leaving the flag True both in memory and on disk even though the slug is no longer provisional.
The `commit` tool's `paths=[]` plus clean-tree code path is only weakly covered; the realistic case where an agent passes real paths that are all already-committed/unchanged is not exercised.
